insights: Lawvere Fixed-Point Theorem (1969) provides categorical unification of all diagonal arguments
If f : alpha to (alpha to beta) is surjective, every g : beta to beta has fixed point via diagonal q x = g(f x x)
Cantor, Russell, Godel, Tarski, Girard are all instances: instantiate with fixed-point-free g
